meta.description: Gives the body paths that pass through their own fill in hyphae_to_mesh, in place of its fill: a closed, smooth stipe next to a cap whose strands show. Every path of the nodes that made them gets it, the other paths keep the fill of hyphae_to_mesh.

plant.description: The paths, they pass through unchanged

fill.description: Where a ball of this many path radii can't pass between these body paths the gap fills, so single paths only show as fibres. 0 shows every path. It counts in radii of the thickest path of the mesh, like the fill of hyphae_to_mesh.
